message: Thanks, Doc and Dennis. I thought about adding outbound links, but the problem with verisimilitude and tone in this genre of 20 minutes into the future semi-SF is exactly what to explain and leave unexplained. Even as well done as Gibson's *Neuromancer* is, the simstim explanation of cyberspace that Case takes in early on is a bit awkward, because we're supposed to be 20 minutes into the future with Case, seeing things through his eyes, knowing what he knows. I probably should have spelled out JSOC as Joint Special Operations Command, but I'm betting you probably Googled either LTTE or Ilankai Tamils, and my narrator-persona would expect his readers versed in the current events of the future to know that the relationship between Sinhalese Sri Lankans and the Tamil Tigers is one of the big new fronts in the so-called GWOT.
